prompt_head:
Job: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
- (required) Professional experience building and deploying production-grad

output.summary: Systems architect who ships AI agent systems end to end. Built a LangGraph job-fit agent with RAG on pgvector, a human approval step, and Langfuse tracing, gated in CI by an eval suite. Also designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to onboard enterprise clients onto a core platform, so the work covers both the build and the client handoff.

bullets.text: Built Job Fit Agent, a LangGraph agent that scores job postings with RAG on pgvector and drafts documents behind a human approval step.
Enforced evidence-cited outputs with a verify loop and layered prompt injection defense; CI gates on zero unsupported claims and passing both injection test cases.
Shipped the agent with FastAPI, a React/TypeScript dashboard, Postgres, Langfuse tracing, a daily cost cap, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI with 70 tests and an eval gate.
Built tycodes-pipeline, a staged Python ICM pipeline that scores AI visibility of local businesses, with a Google Sheets CRM and draft-only outreach behind human approval.
Built tycodes.app, an AI demo generator with a 6-stage agent pipeline that converts business URLs into 3D scroll demos in ~1 min on Cloudflare Workers.
Engineered Tradecrumb, a Python trading engine combining technical indicators, NLP sentiment, and political triggers, with backtesting and grid-search optimization.
Architected and deployed linkme-intops, an operations CRM module in React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, giving staff an interface for high-value subscription accounts.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments to onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Engineered data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, cutting service delivery times by over 30%.
Constructed database-layer automated data validation pipelines that eliminated 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Mentored and onboarded incoming representatives to reach 15%+ conversion rate benchmarks.
